body.scientific_note: The hex-colour SVG validator defect rejected valid model diagrams in b01 A/B, b03 C and b05 A. Each R1 rewinds to the checkpoint just before the first affected document: cached model outputs and Qwen figures are re-rendered without new calls, every later stage reruns under .rw1 identities, and affected probes and readers rerun. Superseded artifacts are archived. b01 R2 a01 is superseded and its interrupted A_PUBLISH reservation sealed.
